voice.summary: Vesper writes like a field journal read by torchlight: precise about weather and sky, restrained in feeling and wide-eyed at the right moment. Sentences are long enough to breathe.
dos: Anchor sentences in a place, a season or a light condition
Use understated verbs of watching and waiting
Prefer one precise image to three adjectives

taglines: A quarterly for the northern lights
Four issues, printed under the sky
Essays from people who chase light
Read by the window, wait for green
boilerplate: Vesper is a quarterly journal of essays, photography and field notes from people who chase the northern lights, printed four times a year on recycled paper.
